!2 URN:NBN
Each record of type alvin-record must have a permanent id of type URN:NBN. This URN:NBN is used as a stable and long-term identifier. When a new record of type alvin-record is created should the system automatically generate a new URN:NBN. New URN:NBN should have the format: '''urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record-{id}''' where {id} is the record's id in Alvin.

A URN:NBN is permanent and must never be changed after the record has been created. This means that URN:NBN cannot be updated, replaced, or removed on an existing alvin-record record.

More information about URN:NBN can be found here:
https://www.kb.se/pliktleverans-och-isbn/urnnbn/vad-ar-urnnbn.html

!3 Tests
  * '''Case 1''': An alvin-record must have a URN:NBN number matching it's ID after creation
  * '''Case 2''': It must not be possible to manually change the URN:NBN number
  * '''Case 3''': It must not be possible to delete the URN:NBN number

!***> Case 1: An alvin-record must have a URN:NBN number matching it's ID after creation
!define recordType {alvin-record}
!define expectedCreateResult {CREATED}
!define visibility {unpublished}
!define tsVisibility {2026-09-02T14:31:05.408686Z}

!define alvinRecordWithUrn {!-{"name":"record","children":[{"name":"typeOfResource","value":"txt"},{"name":"title","children":[{"name":"mainTitle","value":"fitnesseUrnTest"}]},{"name":"physicalLocation","children":[{"name":"heldBy","children":[{"name":"location","children":[{"name":"linkedRecordType","value":"alvin-location"},{"name":"linkedRecordId","value":"3"}]}]}]},{"name":"recordInfo","children":[{"name":"id","value":"234234"},{"name":"visibility","value":"-!${visibility}!-"},{"name":"validationType","children":[{"name":"linkedRecordType","value":"validationType"},{"name":"linkedRecordId","value":"record"}]},{"name":"dataDivider","children":[{"name":"linkedRecordType","value":"system"},{"name":"linkedRecordId","value":"alvinData"}]},{"name":"permissionUnit","children":[{"name":"linkedRecordType","value":"permissionUnit"},{"name":"linkedRecordId","value":"3"}]}]}]}-!}

We verify that the created record has a URN:NBN generated according to our pattern '''urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record-{id}''', with the correct record ID
!define expectedAlvinRecordWithUrn {=~/(?=.*"name":"id","value":"234234")(?=.*"name":"urn","value":"urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record-234234")/}

!| ChildComparerFixture |
| authToken | type | json | testCreateAndStoreRecord? | getStatusType? | getCreatedId? |
| $alvinAdminAuthToken | ${recordType} | ${alvinRecordWithUrn} | ${expectedAlvinRecordWithUrn} | ${expectedCreateResult} | $urnRecord= |

*!

We verify that the URN:NBN value is still '''urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record-234234'''

!3 URN:NBN Retrieval Service
The Retrieval Service is primarily intended for KB to populate its lookup service so that it points to the current URL for a given URN:NBN, see:
https://www.kb.se/pliktleverans-och-isbn/urnnbn/sla-upp-och-hitta-en-resurs.html

In the Retrieval Service, two endpoints are defined:
 * '''current''' – returns records that have been published during the last 24 hours.
 * '''all''' – returns all records.
 
All records created with Alvin powered by Cora receive URN:NBN in the same series: urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record-[recordId].

'''Url'''{{{https://[environmentUrl]/urn-nbn/[current/all]/[alvin]/}}}
For these tests, we work with two records created by the tests above, in the series '''alvin'''.
 * '''Case 1''': Unpublished records should not be returned by the URN-NBN service.
 * '''Case 2''': New published records with the format urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record-[recordId] should be returned by the URN-NBN service.
 * '''Case 4''': When a record is unpublished, it should no longer be returned by the URN-NBN service.
 * '''Case 5''': If you attempt to read a series that does not exist, the service should return an empty records response.
 * '''Case 6''': A record that was published more than 24 hours ago should not appear in current.
 * '''Case 7''': URL should be included in the response and point to the alvin client.

!***> Case 1: Unpublished records should not be returned by the URN-NBN service. → neither of the two records is included.
We verify that the unpublished record in the alvin series is not included in the result from the service.
!define expectedRecordsNotPresent {!-count(//*[local-name()='identifier'][text()='urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record--!$urnRecord!-'])=0-!}
| Table:smartrics.rest.fitnesse.fixture.RestFixture | ${urnNbnUrl} |
| setHeaders | Accept: application/xml|
| GET | /all/alvin/ | 200 |  | ${expectedRecordsNotPresent} |
*!

!***> Case 2: New published records with the format urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record-[recordId] should be returned by the URN-NBN service. → The Diva record is published and should now be included.
We publish the record that is included in the alvin series.
!define visibility {published}
!define urnnbnValue {!-,{"name":"urn","value":"urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record--!$urnRecord!-"}-!}

!| ChildComparerFixture |
| authToken | type | id | json | testUpdateAndStoreRecord? | getStatusType? | 
| $alvinAdminAuthToken | ${recordType} | $urnRecord| ${alvinUpdateRecordWithUrn} |  | OK | 
*!

We verify that the published record in the alvin series is included in the result from the service.

| Table:smartrics.rest.fitnesse.fixture.RestFixture | ${urnNbnUrl} |
| setHeaders | Accept: application/xml|
| GET | /all/alvin/ | 200 |  | ${identifierExists} |

!***> Case 6: A record that was published more than 24 hours ago should not appear in current.
In order to set the publication date ourselves, we start by changing so that the record type alvin-record does not use visibility. After that, we manually set a publication date during the year 2006 and publish the record. We reset alvin-record to use visibility.
With such an old publication date in place, we then test that it appears in all but not in current.

!***> Set a publication date during the year 2006. 
Save current settings for alvin-record.
!| RememberRecordState |
| type       | id            | version  | remember? |
| recordType | alvin-record   | original | OK        |

Change so that alvin-record does not use visibility, which allows us to set a publication date ourselves.
!| UpdateRecordType |
| id           | idSource     | public | usePermissionUnit | useVisibility | useTrashBin | storeInArchive | useHostRecordForPermissions |update? |
| alvin-record | userSupplied | false  | true              | false         | true        | true           | false					   | OK     |

We publish the record in the alvin series with a publication date during the year 2006.
!define tsVisibility {2006-03-30T14:35:23.218738Z}
!define visibility {published}
!define urnnbnValue {!-,{"name":"urn","value":"urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record--!$urnRecord!-"}-!}
!| ChildComparerFixture |
| authToken             | type          | id                 | json                           | testUpdateAndStoreRecord? | getStatusType? | 
| $alvinAdminAuthToken | ${recordType} | $urnRecord| ${alvinUpdateRecordWithUrn} |                           | OK             | 

Reset alvin-record to use visibility by restoring the saved settings from above.
!| RememberRecordState |
| type       | id          | version  | memoryToStorage? |
| recordType | alvin-record | original | OK               |

*!
We verify that the record in the alvin series is included in '''all'''.
!define identifierExists {!-//*[local-name()='identifier'][text()='urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record--!$urnRecord!-']-!}
| Table:smartrics.rest.fitnesse.fixture.RestFixture | ${urnNbnUrl} |
| setHeaders | Accept: application/xml|
| GET | /all/alvin/ | 200 |  | ${identifierExists} |

We verify that the record in the alvin series is not included in '''current'''.
!define expectedRecordsNotPresent {!-count(//*[local-name()='identifier'][text()='urn:nbn:se:alvin:portal:record--!$urnRecord!-'])=0-!}
| Table:smartrics.rest.fitnesse.fixture.RestFixture | ${urnNbnUrl} |
| setHeaders | Accept: application/xml|
| GET | /current/alvin/ | 200 |  | ${expectedRecordsNotPresent} |

*!
